title: This app's settings file
description: GET and POST /v1/settings. The file is ~/.config/clawdline-next/config.json, never the Swift app's; its keys are the Swift app's spellings. A write is a merge onto what is on disk, atomic, and leaves every other key as it was. A file that is not a JSON object is refused rather than replaced.

exists.description: False before anything has been written. Every key then has the shell's default.

hotkey.description: The file's `hotkey`, or null when the file does not carry one as a string. Null and empty both register nothing in this app: the Swift app is running and owns option+space.

path.description: Where the file is, whether or not it exists.

scope_app.description: The file's `scope_app`, or null when absent — which the shell reads as com.googlecode.iterm2. Empty is every app.

SettingsRequest.description: The keys to change. A null key is left as it is.

hotkey.description: A combination the shell can register (`cmd+shift+k`), or empty for none.

scope_app.description: Bundle identifiers separated by commas, or empty for every app.
